- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Ethical production involves transparency about the supply chain and ensuring fair and safe working conditions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Circular fashion refers to reusing, recycling, or repurposing materials to reduce waste.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Slow fashion encourages investment in quality, timeless pieces instead of fast fashion.
